nom: Naked Sundays Hydrating Glow Mist Setting Spray SPF 50+

avis.texte: Product bottle melted in our house 🤷‍♀️ wish i could include tbe pictuee for some humor

avis.titre: Good product! Little heavy on the dewy finish.
avis.texte: I also noticed if uou dont keep your eyes closed for like 15ish seconds after spraying it can irritate your eyes a little from the SPF im assuming. But i love the concept and convinience of an SPF setting spray! Now i can wear my makeup all day :) would love ti see them make an spf 70 product!
I bought this looking for an SPF setting spray and I'm highly disappointed. It made my eyes water all day and they burned. It's more of a spray sunblock that I wouldn't recommend for your face.
Sprays a nice mist, isn't sticky and I love the smell. Even better, has SPF

I have never used product that burned my eyes this badly. It was so bad, I had to pull over because I couldn't keep my eyes open. And genuinely thought I was gonna go blind. The absolute worst product I have ever purchased.

The product helps keep you safe from the sun, but it does sting a little when putting it on. It's also very glowy. I did have to reach out to Ulta because it came damaged and spilled all over the box, but they gladly sent another one.

avis.titre: Great smell, but broke me out
avis.texte: I rarely get acne but this prodct gave me soooo many pimples that actually HURT! They were so painful to even wash my face, also tried it over makeup & it made my makeup messy.

So disappointed in this product! I love the other spf, but this spray is terrible. The smell is so strong and lingers forever. The scent gives me a headache and feels like something I should not be putting on my face. I would not recommend this spray, and will definitely not repurchase.

avis.titre: Love this as an spf topper
avis.texte: I use this to maintain spf coverage through the day and I love it. They recently changed the spray nozzle from the "micro" mist to a more powerful spray which I think is better than the fine mist. It also may just be like that for the smaller size.

Arrived covered in some kind of substance, including something trapped UNDER the tape?! Tape is also damaged. CS refused to let me exchange by mail because it came same day delivery. Which wasn't announced anywhere before ordering. Insisted I needed to drive to a store or wait for a refund and they will send me a return label in 2-3 days. Unfortunately wont be using this on my trip and now have to pay for a different SPF/Setting spray when i get there.

im not normally sensitive to smell but oh boy this one is too much for me. its chemically and perfumey and lingers. i thought itd go away after a while but i could smell it hours later. it honestly made me nauseous. wish it had worked for me!
It's had a good shine but why such a strong scent for a facial product? Smells Like cotton candy and other sweeteners. Get rid of the scent and maybe I can purchase again!!!

This spray smells like alcohol and stings my skin after spraying on. I don't have acne with open "wounds" so I don't understand the sting it gives me. I also feel like it is very drying. I attempted multiple times to adjust my usage and after two weeks, I guess I'll just give this away since I don't think I can return.

I was really excited to use tbis spray after reading all the positive reviews. This product left my face looking and feeling SO GREASY! It never dried down. It didn't burn my face or eyes even though I have sensitive skin so that's good. But I am still returning it.

I have very dry skin and this made me look greasy which is wild. The mist is really nice though and the concept is great. Ngl I 100% put the elf spf spray in the bottle when it ran out cause I like the mister better but I like the elf product better. Sorry not sorry. Plus the elf one is cheaper. Also the smell was ok but not for me. Glad I have the bottle now though. And yes when asked about it I tell people I put the elf in the bottle I feel no shame.

When a product is advertised as a mist specifically for the face, it shouldnt sting the eyes to the point of severe pain. Ive been wearing sunscreen on my face for over 30 years and none have made my eyes this red or painful. Buyer beware.

The product works (I think) for sun protection. But when I applied it, my eyes started burning for a minute straight, and they were sensitive for the next few hours. Also, the spray somehow managed to be dry looking on my skin but greasy when I touched it? I patted my face and it looked like I had dipped my finger into cooking oil. I think I just happen to be one of those people with sensitive skin 🥲
I would not recommend this product for the face or as a setting spray. It burns my eyes really bad so if your eyes are sensitive to sunscreen you are much better off with a korean sunscreen

This is the best SPF setting spray I've used and I've tried about 5 others. This one is so lightweight and smells amazing. The bottle lasts longer than I expected! I like it over makeup and I also like it just on skin. Excellent product!
This spray is perfect. The mist is very fine and gentle. The product smells fine, but the scent is not overbearing. It works fine on top of makeup.

avis.titre: Effective, but breaks me out and has a very strong scent
avis.texte: I so wanted to love this! As someone who takes daily walks during lunch time, I need a sunscreen refresh that works over makeup. It does that part well, but what doesn't work is the obnoxiously strong scent. I get migraines from strong scents and every time I use it, it triggers one and I can smell it for the rest of the day. It's like an artificial coconut smell. PLUS it triggers whiteheads every time I use it. I would love if this company made an acne/sensitive skin safe alternative that was fragrance free.

This has been part of my routine for years and remains one of my most reliable sunscreen touch‑up products. It layers beautifully over makeup, adds hydration, and leaves a soft, healthy glow—without breaking down coverage. Important note: I use this only for reapplication, not as my primary SPF. It's perfect for midday protection when reapplying a cream or lotion isn't realistic. The mini size is especially useful for travel and everyday carry.

Can someone tell me why a facial spray requires fragrance to this level? It doesn't even smell bad but it's so strong it's DISGUSING. Like biochemical warfare disgusting. If you are at all sensitive to fragrance (I'm don't even consider myself sensitive), stay far away.

I wanted to love this spray. It is very hard to find spf mists for reapplication. This sprays so well, dried quick with beautiful glowy setting. Also the perfect size to travel. I just could not tolerate the strong scent and it triggered my fungal acne.

This sunscreen mist has the strongest smell ive ever smelled. Its not even a nasty smell, its not a good or bad smell, but it is so strong it gave me a headache. I returned it the same day it came. It also left me looking greasy instead of glowy. Seemed like it accentuated my pores. All around I hated it and would not recommend.

I really recommend this sunscreen. It is non sticky, does not feel like anything which i love, not greasy, good smell and spray is really great. The only con is if you are in high heat sun exposure not the best option but great for light exposure or to wear for the day has a beautiful glow!

I like this sunscreen for on-the-go reapplication throughout the day. Cover your eyes! The mist is nice and fine, so it's not a mess. I don't like the smell, please just make it fragrance free. I wish it was non-comedogenic. I also use this sunscreen to spray on my hands in the car while I'm driving when the sun is out. There are things that can be improved, but I am grateful I have this sunscreen in my purse. The travel size is the most adorable little product. I think I will be able to buy the bigger size and pour the sunscreen in the travel size, so I can save money and packaging.

avis.titre: Good spray as long as you take precautions
avis.texte: First time I used this did not go well, my eyes stung so badly and the smell was overwhelming in a bad way. The trick is to hold your breath, cover your eyes with one hand, spray then immediately use a fan to clear the air, it really helped. The first time my eyes watered so badly for an hour after use but using a fan truly helps. Makeup looks nice after. In AZ all the spf helps.

I have dry skin and i really wanted to like this to apply over my makeup. It did make my skin look nice, but it felt oily and sticky on my face all day. It also slipped into my eyes on a winter day (i.e. not even sweating) and burned horribly and made my eyes water. Definitely would not use again
Perfect fine mist, lovely smell, beautiful glass finish! Absolutely will buy again!

Yes it will burn your eyes if you get it inside just like all sunscreens. Don't get it in your eyes and you'll be fine The only way this could be better is it sprayed continuously like hair spray, longer than just a few seconds. Otherwise I will keep buying. This is the only product that could motivate me to apply sunscreen everyday because the other versions (cream, gel) take too long to apply, and it's least irrating brand on the market so far.
It's so easy to apply and reapply this over makeup, my skin looks healthy and refreshed.
Took it to Maui to spray through the day. Love the mist and convenience of the spf on top of the tinted moisturizer.

I use this on myself, my husband, my kids, and any one else that needs some sunscreen on their face. Everyone has loved it. We used it for a trip to Disney World in the summer and no one got sun burnt! It was fantastic!!!!
I love these lip oils! I have all flavors of these & I love them.

avis.titre: Convenient for top ups and rehydrating
avis.texte: Love the mini size. It's perfect for car/purse to top up your spf while out and about. I have mature, combo skin so while I get a bit greasy I can get dry in areas. This is perfect to rehydrate and stay glowy without looking greasy.
I already have this product in full size & its amazing. Feels good on the skin, looks amazing & glowy & I'm protected from the UV rays  Will definitely purchase again.

I bought this because i was looking for a setting spray. I normally use Milk hydro grip, but thought I would give this a try. The description on the site is very misleading. This is a sunscreen spray to apply over makeup, not a setting spray. Will be returning.

I tried this item 2-3 times, at first I was worried about the odor due to some reviews I had seen before, so I guess I was more focus on that, then on the 2 attempt I notice it makes my skin irritated like an allergy reaction a lot of small bumps show up all over my face. I do have sensitive skin, maybe is just not for me.

This is my favorite sunscreen first time I used it was last year in Bali and it was so good to have in my purse to just spray on anytime. It is great for my sensitive skin and it smells amazing. This is by far my favorite product by naked sundays.

I am sooo picky on mineral sunscreens, half of them on the market are advertised as mineral but still contain chemical boosters like Butyloctyl Salicylate. This Naked Sundays spf is one of the few mineral sunscreens that is 100000% mineral. And on top of that, because of the high percentage of zinc oxide in this spf it doubles as a skin soother. If I have a damaged barrier, even at bedtime, I'll slather some of this on my face and the next morning its healed. This is seriously the best mineral sunscreen ever and I hope they never change anything about it cause it's perfect.
My favourite face SPF. I think they have changed the formula since I last used it as well. It isn't as oily and still gives me that pretty glow.
It is a good product and VERY handy if you're sun-safety-crazy as well. Just make sure to cover your eyes when applying. Can be incredibly irritating and uncomfortable if it gets in your eyes :')
Works well to set makeup and during the day to provide a hit of sun protection and hydration.
Super convenience to top up my spf need over my make up ¸¸¸
Gave this to my daughter and she's been using it everyday and really likes it. She's 21. It was too fragranced for me but it's great for a younger girl.
I love this spray. I use it as a makeup setting spray. It sprays nice fine mist. I'm sensitive to fragrances but really enjoy this light scent.
This was a free gift I received and I love it. Makes my skin feel so soft
Always love trying something new. Such a lightweight product and perfect to wear over my makeup.
Love this! Great way to add a bit of spf while setting your makeup
Absolutely love the top off spray. I have the regular size bottle and two of the small ones to travel with, they work great.

This mist is the 3rd one I have bought this year, super glad it was a gift I keep one in my bag and one on my vanity to use in the morning after I complete my makeup. The smell is subtle and I love the SPF and hydration my skin receives. I use a spray here and there through the day to keep my glow up! It is a must have and a need for me. The micro mist makes it last forever and set quickly. A+++

Maybe I misread the description online, but the bottle itself says its meant to be used as an SPF over your setting spray, and throughout the day. I was expecting this to be like the Milani brand that actuallt sets your makeup and happens to have a bit of protection. If youre looking for an easy sunscreen application for your face, this is perfect. If youre looking for setting power, dont buy this. Scent is on the stront side so hold your breath fo at least 10 seconds until it settles.

I'm a Professional MUA and this is the holy grail. I've told all my co workers to get this and also refer to my clients! It gives such a beautiful glow as prep and setting the makeup. AND SPF 50?! It's the total package.
A gentle spray over my make up ensures I'm protected from the sun.
I can't speak on the effectivness of this product because each time it has been applied, I've had to wash it off immediately. Anyone with smell/scent sensitivity should be aware!

I really wanted to like this because I love the concept of an SPF and a setting spray. But the smell was awful, and the dispenser did not spray evenly. I even tried cleaning it out and unclogging it, but it just gave such uneven coverage and I could not deal with the smell and so it just wasn't worth it for me at all.
I love this bundle, please don't discontinue. Apart from the great value, the product blends in so beautifully into the skin, with zero cast, as if I have nothing on... The only sunscreen I use -
If the scent was toned down and the formula was just a tad less greasy, it would be perfect in my opinion.
Great product to ensure that sunscreen is reapplied throughout the day. Adds a beautiful glow!
Love the shine this oil provides not to mention the sun protection! Only issue is that it has a slightly odd taste.

I have dry skin and i was hoping this would give me hydration and extra protection, it smells really bad and even tho i had my mouth closed i still somehow got choked on the scent, it also made my skin feel dry?
I love the idea of a SPF spray to touch up throughout the day but the smell is sooo strong. Please make one without fragrance.

I wanted something that I could easily reapply when I've been out on a summer day or at an event. I like how I can easily just spray this and go, but it does make my eyes sting and irritate them a lot. had to figure out ways to not make sure it got near my eyes since it was not as simple as closing my eyes, spraying and going on with my day. So, something to be mindful of if you have sensitive eyes.

I dont know if this works because i can barely feel it go on my face! The mist is so light that I spray way too much and still sont know if its enough. I'll stick to their sunscreen gel, which I love.
I love this. So easy to use, the smell is beautiful and it feels so light on the skin. Easy to use and the kids dont complain like other spray on products . 10/10
Smells amazing, not sticky and sits well over make up. Always in my handbag
just beware of the smell so dont breath in otherwise nice glow with some SPF!
Easy to apply, smells delish, and my skin is glowing after! Even my Hubby loves it! Best product ever!
I already use the full size product - handy size and who doesn't love a gift with purchse!

avis.titre: Perfect to wear over make up.
avis.texte: I love this spray to have SPF top-up with out ruining my make up. It smells lovely and feels good on the skin. My only Critism is can get really stingy if it gets into your eyes (obvs close them when I spray but can leave some residue) And wearing contact lenses, I find it irritates easily.
This stuff smells fantastic, not like sunscreen or chemicals at all. Protects my face and neck when I'm out and about. Always in my bag.

avis.titre: SPF50+ Glow Face Mist Top Up Spray
avis.texte: I love this spray it smells fresh but not a strong smell, gives a great glow to the skin as well and its 50+
Was worried i would burn but im pasty white and it covered everything no burns and smelt delicious

avis.titre: Greasy and smudged my eyeliner and mascara
avis.texte: To be fair, I've only used this once. The positives are that the mist is good and didn't feel like it was spraying a ton of product on the skin. However, the negatives are that it is really too greasy for my liking AND it smudged my normally smudge-proof eye liner and mascara. I waited a few hours for the greasiness to tone down but it didn't, so I had to powder it a bit. I might have used it more in the summer but it's just too greasy for me and smudging my eye make up is a deal-breaker.
Wow, I cant put in to words how horrible this smells! Its also so incredibly greasy.
Ordered this all the way to Canada and it was so worth it. Really nice product and I'm glad to have my makeup looking nice and skin protected with SPF.
I love the smell! It feels nice on the skin. The mist comes out pretty light and you can barely tell that It's on, so I don't know if that's a good or a bad thing. It's definitely a new staple!
It's been about a week since I've started to use it and I like it so far. Hold your breath while spraying onto face but the mist and pump and application are all great!
Love that it's a mist + sunscreen + gives you the perfect glow, this mist is both hydrating and refreshing. The glow it gives is AMAZING and It's a non greasy formula, love it

I bought this as an easy way to touch-up my SPF when on the go but the scent and the mist application are just not a good fit for me. I found the mist to be too light/wide of a spray, so it didn't feel like I was actually getting the coverage I needed. The scent was also overpowering, especially when spraying directly on my face, and left me feeling nauseated.

avis.titre: Wanted to love, burned my eyes
avis.texte: Was really loving the concept of setting spray + SPF, but unfortunately this really burned my eyes after about two hours of wear. I'm more on the oily side, so maybe this would work for someone that wasn't as oily, but was a return for me after one use.

avis.titre: SPF50+ Hydrating Glow Face Mist Top Up Spray
avis.texte: Love this spray. Perfect for a top up spray if outside or in car driving. This is a must for Summer. The smell is addictive. Light and Fresh. Does smell like an spf but in a good way. Leaves a nice sheen.

Love using this stuff daily! It makes my skin look amazing and I feel It's made a difference I my skin. I would definitely recommend! It does pill under certain makeup items and skincare that I've noticed, so I would be careful on that part.
I love this SPF. I use it every day. I love how I can reapply it over my makeup and it does not mess up my makeup.

avis.titre: Great value on an amazing product
avis.texte: Absolutely LOVE this product - can't stop telling everyone about it. Wish I'd found it sooner, it's perfect.

I love this sunscreen and its easy application but the only reason I gave 4 stars is because of the very strong smell causing me to sneeze everytime and a very strong scent for mothers who have babies

I've been wanting to find a good lipgloss, but they always feel so sticky. This one goes on smooth like butter and feels and smells amazing! So glad this was a free gift because now I'm a loyal customer.

This spray is it! If you love the dewy look and this helps accomplish that. I love that I can spray on spf and get a fire look on top of my make up. The smell is great too but if you're sensitive to smells this may be too much for you as the smell stays with you all day until you wash it off which is what i love.
I absolutely love this product. I use it to reapply my sunscreen every two hours. I usually don't like anything scented, but the scent is delicious!
It's so easy to apply especially when I have makeup! My favorite sunscreen
This is great ! It is not sticky or greasy . It smells amazing and looks awesome

Terrible smell of old watermellon aside You need to apply to your hands before applying to your face (as per instructions), avoiding the eye areas You need to reapply if you plan on swimming, water on your face, or sweating a lot (as per instructions and use) Make your own judgments now

I had seen some reviews of this product and decided to try it. I have now bought multiple bottles and so has my sister. I really like that it's a high SPF and the price point is fantastic - but the absolute best part is the spray. It is a true micro-mist! I could barely tell it was even spraying it was so light. It is great for taking with you and re-application. Highly recommend!
The scent alone earns it one star because it is both disgusting and overwhelmingly strong, it's very unnecessary.
Love it! Super practical and convenient to use throughout the day. Smells amazing also!

I've been using the new sunscreen mist for about a month and I absolutely love it. I love how easy it is to not only just spritz and move on, but to carry in my purse. If there was one thing I would like to change is for it to be fragrance free. I prefer my skincare to not have a scent or for the scent to linger. But overall I'll give it 4.5 stars
